methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size, in slots, of this inventory.
methods.shortDescription: Get the size of the inventory.

returnValues.name: size
returnValues.description: The size, in slots, of this inventory.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a sparse list of basic item data contained within the inventory.
methods.shortDescription: Get a list of items in the inventory.

returnValues.name: items
description: A sparse list of basic item data tables. The key is the slot number, and the value is the item data. The following data is stored in each table:
- `name`: The name of the item, for example, `"minecraft:stick"`
- `count`: The amount of the item in the slot.
- `nbt`: A potentially nil value containing the hash of the nbt data.
See `getItemDetail` if you need more information about an item.
returnValues.shortDescription: A list of items in the inventory.

methods.name: getItemDetail
methods.description: Returns detailed information about a single item in the inventory.
methods.shortDescription: Gets detailed info about a single item.

arguments.name: slot
arguments.description: The slot of the item you want to get more detail about.
arguments.shortDescription: The slot to get information about.

returnValues.name: detailedInfo
description: Detailed information about an item. This includes information from `list`, as well as some more:
- `displayName`: The actual display name of the item, for example, "Stick".
